player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} na Njikọ Anọ. Ihe ngosi diski gị: {symbol}. Ogwe egwuregwu nwere {num_rows} ahịrị na {num_cols} ogidi. Ndị egwuregwu na-agbanwe agbanwe na-atụba diski ha n'ime otu n'ime ogidi (0 ruo {end_col}). Onye mbụ jikọtara diski anọ (nke ha) n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ, n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ, ma ọ bụ diagonal na-emeri. Na oge gị, tinye nọmba kọlụm na brackets square iji mee ka ị kwalite. Dịka ọmụmaatụ: '[col 4]' ma ọ bụ '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: A naghị ahụ bọọdụ egwuregwu ahụ anya.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id}, Ụdị ihe na-abaghị uru. Ụdị a tụrụ anya ya: "[col x]".
invalid_move.out_of_range: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id}, Ihe na-abaghị uru. Kọlụm {col} dị n'èzí.
invalid_move.already_full: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id}, Ihe na-abaghị uru. Kọlụm {col} jupụtara.

action.dropped_disk: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} na-adaba diski ha ({player_symbol}) n'ime kọlụm {col}.

outcome.win: Onye na-egwu {player_id} na-emeri site na ijikọta anọ!
